verdict.rationale: Docs mention health insurance is available via a partner (SimplyInsured) alongside other benefits like 401(k) and workers comp, and Gusto's payroll platform separately supports deductions/benefits configuration in payrolls (e.g., benefits deduction blocking language for bonus payrolls). However, there is no detailed documentation of the health-insurance enrollment workflow or explicit description of how enrollments/deductions sync to payroll for that offering. Missing for 10: dedicated health-insurance enrollment/administration guide, explicit deduction-sync mechanics, and independent confirmation of the feature working end-to-end.
